about: Select many notes in the list, then one popup: add a tag, move to a folder, merge into one note, delete to the bin. Pure core in bulk.js; local here until a second kind of app wants it.
html: #select and #bulk-bar in the list's top bar, the #bulk dialog, the switch #opt-bulkEdit
